annotations.text: INSURE THAT ALL GATE VOLTAGES ARE NOMINAL ± 2 PERCENT
USE A 453 OR EQUIVALENT OSCILLOSCOPE WITH PRE-AMPS AND
PROBES ADJUSTED PER MANUFACTURER'S PROCEDURE.
THIS ADJUSTMENT IS TO BE PERFORMED WITH THE C E IN STATE
ZERO TEST MODE, WITH INHIB CE HARD STOP SW ON.
NOTE: A NON-METALIC ADJUSTMENT TOOL WILL HAVE THE LEAST
EFFECT ON SUBSEQUENT MEASUREMENTS. HOWEVER, IF A METALIC
TOOL IS USED IT MUST BE REMOVED FROM THE POT SCREW SLOT
BEFORE AN ACCURATE READING CAN BE TAKEN.
STEP 1
PLACE THE FREQUENCY ALTER SWITCH ON THE C E PANEL IN THE
DISABLE POSITION. DEPRESS THE RESET PUSHBUTTON AND ADJUST
SINGLE SHOT KC101AS (02E-E2F7-D13)CENTER POT FOR 1.2±.2 US.
STEP 2
THIS OUTPUT REPRESENTS THE DIFFERENCE FREQUENCY BETWEEN
THE 5.0 MHZ DELAY LINE OSCILLATOR AND THE 5.0 MHZ CRYSTAL
OSCILLATOR WHICH IS BEING USED AS A STANDARD. THIS
DIFFERENCE FREQUENCY MAY VARY AS MUCH AS 1 KC DUE TO POWER
SUPPLY TRANSIENTS ETC.
COARSE FREQUENCY ADJUST  (5.0 MHZ OSC)
CHECK THE FREQUENCY OF THE OUTPUT OF THE
FREQUENCY COMPARATOR CARD (E-D2L2-B02).
ADJUST THE TRIM POT OF THE DELAY LINE OSCILLATOR CARD
(E-D2J5) TO REDUCE THE FREQUENCY TO A MINIMUM (LESS THAN
30 KHZ) OR A NULL IF POSSIBLE. IF A NULL CANNOT BE
OBTAINED, THE PERIOD MUST BE GREATER THAN 35 US. SEE FIG. 1
┌─FREQ COMPARATOR OUTPUT (SINE WAVE)

THE FOLLOWING ADJUSTMENT METHOD COMPARES THE
DURATION OF THE POSITIVE AND NEGATIVE HALVES OF
THE CLOCK WITHOUT ATTEMPTING TO GET AN ABSOLUTE
MEASURE OF DURATION. IT IS THEREFORE INDEPENDENT
OF SCOPE CALIBRATION.
A.  SYNC INTERNAL POSITIVE AND ALIGN THE LEADING EDGE
OF PLUS CLOCK AT THE 1.2 V LEVEL WITH THE FIRST
DIVISION. IF THE 1.9 V LEVEL AT THE TRAILING EDGE
IS NOT WITHIN THE GRATICULE, ADJUST THE VARIABLE
SWEEP SPEED UNTIL IT IS. NOW NOTE THE POSITIVE PULSE
WIDTH FROM THE LEADING 1.2 V LEVEL TO THE TRAILING
1.9 V LEVEL. THIS WIDTH WILL NOW BE COMPARED TO THE
NEGATIVE CLOCK DURATION, SO THE SWEEP SPEED MUST NOT
BE CHANGED FROM HERE ON.
B.  CHANGE THE SCOPE SYNC FROM POSITIVE TO NEGATIVE.
ALIGN THE LEADING EDGE OF THE NEGATIVE PORTION
OF THE CLOCK AT THE 1.9 V LEVEL WITH THE FIRST
DIVISION. NOTE THE NEGATIVE PULSE WIDTH FROM THE
LEADING 1.9 V LEVEL TO THE TRAILING 1.2 V LEVEL.
THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THIS NEGATIVE DURATION AND
THE POSITIVE DURATION MEASURED EARLIER IS THE
SYMMETRY ERROR. SEE FIG 2. ADJUST THE SYMMETRY CONTROL
POT (E-D2H6) IF REQUIRED, TO REDUCE THE SYMMETRY
ERROR TO 0±2 NSEC.
STEP 4
FINE FREQUENCY ADJUST (5.0 MHZ OSC)
REPEAT STEP 2 ADJUSTING THE DIFFERENCE FREQUENCY TO A NULL
OR MINIMUM PERIOD NORMALLY GREATER THAN 1 MILLISECOND
(LESS THAN 1 KHZ). SEE FIG. 1.
NOTE: CLOSING THE CARD RETAINING COVER ON E-D2 BOARD MAY
TEND TO DECREASE OSCILLATOR FREQUENCY. THEREFORE,
THE FREQUENCY SHOULD BE RECHECKED AFTER THE COVER
IS CLOSED.
STEP 5
PLACE THE FREQUENCY ALTER SWITCH ON THE C E PANEL IN THE
ENABLE POSITION AND PRESS THE RESET PUSH BUTTON.
ADJUST THE FREQUENCY OF THE 5.125 MHZ TRIM POT AT E-D2M5
USING THE ADJUSTING PROCEDURE OF STEP 2. THEN ADJUST THE
SYMMETRY CONTROL POT AT E-D2L6 USING THE PROCEDURE OF
STEP 3. BE SURE TO USE ADJUSTING POTS FOR THE FREQUENCY
ALTER DELAY LINE AS GIVEN IN THIS PARAGRAPH
STEP 6
FINE FREQUENCY ADJUST (5.125 MHZ OSC)
REPEAT STEP 2 (TRIM POT AT E-D2M5) ADJUSTING THE
DIFFERENCE FREQUENCY FOR A NULL, OR IF A NULL CANNOT
BE OBTAINED, TO A PERIOD GREATER THAN 1 MILLISECOND.
SEE FIG. 1. WHEN THIS ADJUSTMENT IS COMPLETE, RETURN
THE FREQUENCY ALTER SWITCH ON THE C E CONSOLE TO
THE DISABLE POSITION AND PRESS THE RESET PUSH BUTTON.
NOTE 1:
IF FOR SOME REASON THE DELAY LINE OSCILLATOR TRIM POT
ADJUSTMENT HAS NO EFFECT OR DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT
RESPONSE TO REDUCE THE OUTPUT OF THE COMPARATOR CARD TO
WITHIN TOLERANCE SEQUENTIALLY CHECK THE FOLLOWING:
A. REPEAT STEP 1.
B. SCOPE THE OUTPUT OF THE CRYSTAL OSCILLATOR (E-E2G3-D02)
TO INSURE IT IS PROVIDING A CLOCK SIGNAL APPROXIMATELY
2.5V P-P AT APPROX. 5.0 MHZ TO THE COMPARATOR CARD.
IF THERE IS NO OUTPUT OR IF THE FREQUENCY IS OBVIOUSLY
INCORRECT, REPLACE THE OSCILLATOR CARD.
C. CHECK THE OUTPUT OF THE SYMMETRY CONTROL CARD AT
E-D2H6-B02 (5.125 MHZ E-D2L6-B02) FOR AN INITIAL
SETTING. THIS OUTPUT SHOULD BE 1.33V. AFTER THE
SYMMETRY ADJUSTMENT HAS BEEN MADE, THE SYMMETRY CONTROL
POTS SHOULD PROVIDE 1.33V±0.20V. IF THIS ADJUSTMENT
CANNOT BE MADE, REPLACE THE SYMMETRY CONTROL CARD.
D. SCOPE THE OUTPUT OF THE DELAY LINE OSCILLATOR AT
F-D2J5-D17 (5.125 MHZ F-D2M5-D12). THIS OUTPUT SHOULD
BE A CLOCK SIGNAL AT APPROX. 2.5VP-P AND 5.0 MHZ
(5.125 MHZ). IF THIS SIGNAL IS LESS THAN 2.0VP-P OR
THERE IS NO OUTPUT, REPLACE THE DELAY LINE OSCILLATOR
CARD.
E. SCOPE THE OUTPUT OF THE FREQUENCY COMPARATOR CARD AT
F-D2L2-B02. THIS OUTPUT SHOULD BE APPROXIMATELY 0.5VP-P
AND SHOULD VARY IN FREQUENCY AS THE DELAY LINE
OSCILLATOR TRIM POT IS ADJUSTED. IF THIS OUTPUT DOES
NOT VARY AS A FUNCTION OF DELAY LINE OSCILLATOR
FREQUENCY ADJUSTMENT, REPLACE THE COMPARATOR CARD.
DELAY LINE CLOCK
ALIGNMENT PROCEDURE
